pred_ddx.label: Transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder

pred_reasoning_trace:
Observed:
- Right flank pain
- Hematuria
- Dysuria
- Focal hypoechoic polypoidal lesion in the bladder
- Heterogeneous enhancement of the lesion on CT
- 46-year-old woman
- Past medical history of abdominal hysterectomy
- Unremarkable general and pelvic examinations
- Urinalysis showed 6–8 red blood cells and 4–6 pus cells per high-power field
- Ultrasound showed a focal hypoechoic polypoidal lesion in the bladder
- CT showed a well-defined soft-tissue–density lesion with calcific specks along the anterosuperior bladder wall
- Lesion demonstrated heterogeneous enhancement on CT
- Right calyceal calculus with mild pelvicalyceal dilatation
- Simple right renal cyst
- Left hydrosalpinx
Differential diagnosis:
1. Papillary urothelial carcinoma
2. Transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder
3. Urothelial carcinoma with squamous differentiation
4. Bladder endometriosis
5. Malacoplakia of the bladder
